description: Provision a Google Cloud Storage StorageNotification via Config Connector. Fields mirror the storage.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 StorageNotification spec.

bucketRef.description: Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `StorageBucket` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

customAttributes.description: Immutable.  A set of key/value attribute pairs to attach to each Cloud Pub/Sub message published for this notification subscription.

eventTypes.description: Immutable. List of event type filters for this notification config. If not specified, Cloud Storage will send notifications for all event types. The valid types are: "OBJECT_FINALIZE", "OBJECT_METADATA_UPDATE", "OBJECT_DELETE", "OBJECT_ARCHIVE".

objectNamePrefix.description: Immutable. Specifies a prefix path filter for this notification config. Cloud Storage will only send notifications for objects in this bucket whose names begin with the specified prefix.

payloadFormat.description: Immutable. The desired content of the Payload. One of "JSON_API_V1" or "NONE".

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The service-generated notificationId of the resource. Used for acquisition only. Leave unset to create a new resource.

topicRef.description: Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: string of the format `projects/{{project}}/topics/{{value}}`, where {{value}} is the `name` field of a `PubSubTopic` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

title: GCP Storage StorageNotification
